name: Superwhisper
tagline: AI dictation for Mac that turns speech into text anywhere

pricing.notes: Official docs/checkout checked 2026-07-30; Pro monthly listed at $8.49, annual $84.99, lifetime $249.99.

verdictSummary: A push-to-talk recorder that transcribes and pastes text into the active app is very buildable for one person, especially on macOS.
coreLoopDIY: Bind a hotkey, capture microphone audio, transcribe with Whisper or speech API, optionally rewrite with an LLM, and paste into the active field.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay for the low-friction menu-bar experience and dictation profiles.

priorArt.name: whisper.cpp
priorArt.desc: Local transcription engine that makes a simple dictation clone realistic.

notes: Strong yes and very on-brand for vibecoding: small utility, obvious primitives, high subscription annoyance.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Superwhisper (AI dictation for Mac that turns speech into text anywhere). Requirements:

- Core loop: Bind a hotkey, capture microphone audio, transcribe with Whisper or speech API, optionally rewrite with an LLM, and paste into the active field.
- Needs: macOS automation/accessibility permissions.
- Needs: speech API or local Whisper.
- Needs: optional LLM API.
- Needs: hotkey library.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: beautiful native UX; presets; vocabulary/profile tuning.
